article.part: Caso avanzado y cantidad — Продвинутый падеж и количество
article.chapter: Animacidad, sincretismo y alternancias de caso — Одушевлённость, синкретизм и падежные чередования

claims.summary: In Russian, plural accusative forms of inanimate nouns match nominative plural, while animate plural accusatives match genitive plural.
The animacy contrast applies across plural declensions and is illustrated by animate human nouns and inanimate objects.
The accusative remains the syntactic case even where its surface form is syncretic with nominative or genitive.
Genitive plural also appears with нет, as distinct from accusative objects whose form may coincide with genitive.
Animacy is a grammatical classification; some lexemes can vary in animacy, so dictionary usage may be needed.
Genitive plural surface forms vary by noun paradigm and cannot be derived as one universal ending from the accusative animacy rule.
